question: Linked employer-employee microdata with worker and firm IDs, 10+ year panel, for AKM decomposition of wage inequality into within- and between-firm parts

requirements.text: Worker ID and employer ID on each job record

record.title: Linked-Employer-Employee-Daten des IAB (LIAB): LIAB- Längsschnittmodell 1975-2024, Version 1

access.evidence: FDZ Data Usage Agreement; weakly anonymous data via research visit/remote access only

record.description: Die Linked-Employer-Employee-Daten des IAB (LIAB) kombinieren die Interviews des IAB-Betriebspanels mit den zugehörigen Betriebs- und Personendaten aus den Prozessen der Bundesagentur für Arbeit. Letztere umfassen einerseits die administrativen Betriebsinformationen aus dem Betriebs-Historik-Panel (BHP) und andererseits die Erwerbsbiographien der in den interviewten Betrieben beschäftigten Personen. Die LIAB Daten ermöglichen somit eine simultane Analyse der Angebots- und Nachfrageseite des Arbeitsmarktes.
record.publisher: Forschungsdatenzentrum (FDZ) der Bundesagentur für Arbeit (BA) im Institut für Arbeitsmarkt- und Berufsforschung (IAB)

sentences: Due to size restrictions, the employment biographies of all employees can only be provided for establishments with up to 49 employees subject to social security.

With your application to LIAB, we provide automatically data from the IAB Establishment Panel for all establishments with linkage consent, the administrative individual data, and the Basis Establishment File of the BHP.
Further modules of the BHP have to be requested explicitly in your application.
According to the FDZ Data Usage Agreement, any type of publication resulting from work with FDZ data must be reported to the FDZ by email at the latest one month after publication.

datasets.why: German social-security records linked to employers from 1975; the standard AKM data (Card-Heining-Kline). LIAB longitudinal model 1975-2024 is on-site/remote only.

R3.evidence: Employment biographies provided only for establishments up to 49 employees in this model; check cross-sectional model / full IEB
